artworks.title: Xenocrates and Phryne
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with three figures. The scene is set in a sparsely furnished stone room with wooden beams overhead, partially draped with a cloth. At the center, a person reclines on a simple bed, absorbed in reading a tablet. To their right, another figure, mostly naked, reclines against the reader, their long hair falling over the linens. On the right side, a third figure peeks through parted curtains, appearing to observe the scene. The balance between light and shadow, along with the character's postures, adds a contemplative tone to the illustration. The scene feels intimate and historically stylized, reminiscent of classical antiquity. The composition is intricately detailed, capturing the setting's atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Peasant Eating
artworks.artist: Anton Spreng after Adriaen Brouwer; published by Joseph Eder
artworks.medium: aquatint and etching printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Gregory Jecmen
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up, leaning slightly forward over a table. His position is somewhat hunched, with his right elbow resting on the table, and his hand close to his mouth. The man has shaggy, unkempt hair that appears medium to long in length, with his fringe falling over his forehead. His facial expression is characterized by a broad grin, with distinct, weathered features including pronounced cheekbones and a prominent chin. He is wearing a loose-fitting garment, possibly a shirt or tunic, with sleeves that appear slightly rolled or bunched. The table in front of him is flat and simple, with a few small indistinct objects placed upon it. In the background, there is a plain, unadorned surface that highlights the man's figure within the oval framing of the image. The overall color scheme is a muted brown, giving a monochrome or sepia-like effect.

artworks.title: Libro Appartenente al Architettura [Title Page]
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century, after Antonio Labacco, published by Giovanni Boni
artworks.dimensions:
overall size (volume closed): 40.6 x 30.2 cm (16 x 11 7/8 in.)
plate: 32.7 × 22.2 cm (12 7/8 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural frontispiece with classical elements and symbols. The illustration features an ornate archway, two allegorical figures at the top, and a central cartouche with text mentioning a book on architecture by Antonio Labacco. The scene below shows a classical landscape with ruins, architectural elements, and Roman-looking structures in the distance. The drawing emphasizes the beauty and legacy of ancient Roman architecture, influenced by Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: Topographical Map of Ancient Rome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: Printed with black ink on white paper, this map shows a bird’s-eye views of a river winding through a town surrounded by empty fields and hills, all encased in city walls. The buildings and fields are spaced over several hills, many of which are labeled in Latin in all capital letters. The hills are finely crosshatched to suggest depth, and the buildings are drawn roughly in perspective, as if looking across the city from a high vantage point. Near the center of the engraving, densely packed buildings are separated by thin gaps to create irregular city blocks. The crowded blocks give way to open space and hills dotted with buildings, steeples, and ruins. Fragments of free-standing rows of arches in the fields to the south are the remains of aqueducts. The city wall is punctuated by arched openings framed by abutments that project above the top of the walls. The river winds from the top left corner of the paper to the center of the right edge, intersecting with the city walls in two places. Dozens of hills, features, landmarks, and buildings are labeled, including the round, domed “PANTEON” in the middle of the town, “CAPITOLINVS” a few blocks to our left, and “PALANTINVS” to our left of center. Near the upper right corner of the paper, several building-lined streets lead up to a hill labeled “VATICANVS.” Beyond the city walls the page is almost entirely blank. The page is folded vertically up the center. In the lower right corner, an inscription in a tablet-like cartouche reads, “RECENS RVRSVS POST OMNES OMNIVM DES CRIPTION. VRB, ROMAE TOPOGRAPHIA. CVM VALLIS. FOSSIS AGGRISVS CAETERISQ. QVAE AD HOSTI VM IMPEDIEND. IRRVPTION. PER VNIVERSVM VRB.AMBITVM INTRA EXTRAQ. MOEN. PVB LIC. IMPEN. FIERI CVRAVIT PAVL. IIII. PONT. MAX. DVM BELLO PARTHENOP. PREMERETVR. FORMIS ANTON.LAFRE RIL. SEQVAN. DILIGENTISS. EXPRESS. AN. D. LVII. CON GRA ET PREVILEGIO.” A thin, line border frames the map near the edge of the paper.

artworks.title: Topographical Map of Modern Rome
artworks.artist: Sebastiano di Re after Giovanni Antonio Dosio
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu

artworks.title: Capitoline Wolf with Romulus and Remus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: Printed with delicate black lines and hatching on cream-white paper, a she-wolf stands as two male infants attempt to nurse at her teats in this horizontal engraving. The wolf stands sideways facing our left with her head turned to look at us, eight teats hanging heavily along her underside. Her wide eyes are framed by raised but furrowed brows, and cup-like ears curl back on her round head. Her jaws are slightly open revealing sharp teeth. Her lean body is partly covered by tight clusters of parallel, undulating lines around her head, neck, and along her back, suggesting fur. Beneath her, one boy sits, rocking back on a low rock, and the other kneels. Both tilt their heads back and spread their arms wide as they reach for her teats. The wolf and boys are on a slab-like plinth, which in turn rests on a base inscribed with text on its face. The Latin text reads, “LVPAE ROMVLVM ET REMVM VRBIS CONDITORES LACTANTIS ANTIQVVM AC AENEVM IN CAPITOLIO SIGNVM. ANT LAFRERII FORMIS ROMAE MDLII.”

artworks.title: Equestrian Statue of Marcus Aurelius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a statue of a horse-mounted figure. The equestrian statue is detailed and elevated on a pedestal with an inscription. The horse is in a dynamic pose with one leg raised, while the figure is dressed in classical attire. The pedestal is elaborate and features a Latin inscription. The artwork emphasizes precision and detail in the line work and depiction of the statue's features.

artworks.title: Arch of Constantine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural monument, specifically a triumphal arch. The structure features three archways, with a large central arch flanked by two smaller ones. The arch is richly decorated with carvings, reliefs, and inscriptions. The reliefs depict various figures and scenes, and are surrounded by detailed architectural elements such as columns and pilasters. Above the central arch, there is a large Latin inscription. The base of the monument sits atop a checkerboard pattern floor.

artworks.title: Arch of the Claudian Aqueduct
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient Roman arch. The drawing shows a Roman arch with three large archways, each flanked by smaller niches. The surface has inscriptions in Latin. The stone facade is textured, showing individual blocks and 3D structure. Classical elements like pilasters and entablature are depicted. The perspective leads the viewer's eye through the central archway.

artworks.title: Colosseum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural illustration of the Colosseum from a slightly elevated point of view. The focus is on the structure's interior and exterior design. The horizon is not visible, and the sky above shows clouds. The right side displays the circular exterior wall with arcades and arches, while the left side shows a cutaway view revealing tiers of seating and the arena floor with geometric designs. The illustration style is precise, likely an engraving with sharp lines and shading to depict the stonework texture and depth. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray, emphasizing light, shadow, and architectural forms.

artworks.title: Colosseum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of the Roman Colosseum from a slightly elevated perspective. The sandy ground ascends towards the structure, with no distinct features on the horizon. The etching technique highlights the cracks, crevices, and vegetation on the ruins. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing the architectural details against the sky. An inscription "THEATRVM SIVE COLISEVM ROMANVM" is below the ground.

artworks.title: Tomb of Nero
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lois and Robert Erburu
artworks.description: The sculpture is an ancient-looking monument featuring several carved figures and a central inscription panel. The main body of the sculpture is rectangular and adorned with classical columns on either side of the inscribed text. On the upper portion, a curved pediment is embellished with reliefs, including a winged figure and other detailed carvings. On the side, there is a depiction of a griffin-like creature and a bull's head. The sculpture is positioned atop a weathered, layered stone base. The sculpture appears to be made of stone or marble and is represented in a monochromatic color scheme with various shades of grey and white. It is intricately crafted with precise, detailed elements indicative of a historical or commemorative purpose. The overall appearance suggests a solemn and formal monument, likely meant to convey significance and respect.

artworks.title: An Elderly Lady in a Mauve Silk Dress
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image depicts an older woman from the waist up, seated at a slight angle facing the left and looking directly at the viewer. She has soft facial features with subtle wrinkles, light-colored eyes, and a gentle expression. Her gray hair is mostly covered by a lace cap with ribbons. She is wearing a richly decorated garment with layers of lace, patterned fabric, and a large bow at the neckline, featuring embroidered details. The background has a muted gradient of blues and browns.

artworks.title: Gen. U.S. Grant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III and Gregory E. Mescha in memory of Francis J. Lynch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body, facing forward with a slight turn to his left. They appear stern, with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and well-groomed beard. Their hair is short and neatly combed back. They are wearing a formal military uniform with decorative buttons and a collar insignia featuring three stars. The portrait is in an oval frame at the center of a rectangular border. The name "GEN. U.S. GRANT" is inscribed below the oval. The background is plain with a subtle texture around the oval frame.

artworks.title: The Amorous Nun between the Abbot and the Monk
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within image): 24.2 x 30.4 cm (9 1/2 x 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a medieval interior scene. The image shows a room centered around a round table covered with a cloth, featuring various dishes displayed on top. In the foreground, a person is seated on a high-backed chair gesturing with a skewer. The table is laden with food including a loaf of bread, poultry, and other items. There are objects like pots and jugs scattered around the floor. 

To the left, there is a roaring fire in a hearth, with smoke curling upwards. Details such as a cat on the floor and a small dog beside the table are visible. On the right, another person is attending to someone sitting, draped in a cloak. In the background, individuals are engaged in conversation or music in a brightly lit space beyond a doorway lined with windows. The drawing depicts a scene filled with details of medieval living.

artworks.title: Volendam Girl in Costume
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jill Newhouse and Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting in profile on a chair, with her hands on her lap. She has a refined expression, wearing a white cap with lace, a dark dress, a white shawl, and a striped skirt. She also wears a colorful choker necklace. The background is plain brown with hints of green and orange.

artworks.title: Abraham Lincoln
artworks.medium: engraving on chine collé mounted to wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III and Gregory E. Mescha in memory of Francis J. Lynch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man identified as Abraham Lincoln. The portrait shows the head and upper torso of the man who is slightly turned to his right, looking forward. He has unique facial features, including a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a strong jawline with a full beard along his chin and jaw. His hair is dark, wavy, and combed back from his face. The man is dressed in a black suit jacket over a white shirt with a bowtie. There is no visible jewelry. The background features an oval frame with textured and decorative elements. The area within the frame is plain, providing contrast to the man's attire and facial features. The name "Abraham Lincoln" is inscribed at the bottom of the frame within the portrait.

artworks.title: Tufa Domes, Pyramid Lake, Nevada
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal landscape with a calm body of water, a rocky shoreline, a rocky hill in the distance, and several people near a boat. The sky is a soft sepia tone, and the scene has a monochromatic palette emphasizing textures.

artworks.title: Vache Garonnaise, agée de 5 à 6 ans
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing behind a cow, with the person's head and lower legs visible. The person appears to be wearing a cap and dark clothing with tall boots. The cow is standing sideways, and the background is plain fabric with a ground covered in coarse material.

artworks.title: Arcueil-Cachan, Parc de Madame de Provigny
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a grassy area with scattered sticks, logs, and a stone structure in the foreground. Trees surround the area, leading the eye to a grand classical building in the distance. An arched viaduct can be seen on the horizon. The color palette is sepia-toned, creating a nostalgic feel with soft contrasts.

artworks.title: Cupid with Psyche Extinguishing the Lamp
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray wash and white heightening on brown prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures on a circular bed. One figure is reclining on their back, eyes closed, while the other figure is perched above, reaching outward. The figure above has curly hair and wings. Both figures are unclothed, and the scene is dimly lit. The bed is elevated with soft bedding, and there is a bedpost with a small figurine on top. The setting suggests an intimate space with rich textures and dark tones.

artworks.title: Presentation Drawing for the Ceiling Fresco of the Ognissanti
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and brown wash and watercolor over traces of chalk on four joined pieces of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Director's Discretionary Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design for a decorative ceiling. The drawing features a detailed perspective of a Baroque-style ceiling, with various moldings, arches, panels, ornamental motifs, and balustrades. The color scheme is grey and golden, with shading emphasizing the architectural features.

artworks.title: Elegantly Dressed Soldier Preparing to Fire His Caliver
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a bent posture. He has a serious expression with furrowed brows and is dressed in detailed armor, including a helmet and a vest with padded sleeves. He is holding a smoking musket with both hands. The man's boots have woven patterns around the top. The background is simple and neutral.

artworks.title: Venus, Juno and Minerva
artworks.artist: Adriaen Collaert after Jan van der Straet
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 21 x 15.4 cm (8 1/4 x 6 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three nude female figures from head to toe, positioned in a classical and symbolic manner. The first woman on the left stands upright, her head slightly inclined, with her eyes closed, and her hair styled back away from her face. She is draped with a flowing cloth around her hips that moves with a sense of flowing motion. Next to her, a cherub-like figure holds onto her drapery. The second woman, in the center, appears to be sitting or leaning on a cloud, holding a scepter-like object, with her gaze directed forward. Her hair is pulled back and she is crowned with a crescent. The third woman on the right is turned slightly away from the viewer but looks over her shoulder, her gaze directed towards an object at the back. Her hair is covered with a helmet adorned with intricate designs, and she holds a shield in her left hand. The background features swirling clouds that the figures rest upon. The names "VENERIS," "IVNO," and "MINERVA" are inscribed next to each figure.
